issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
 > latest master

<!-- **NOTE:** Do not submit bug reports about anything but the two most recently released (non-rc) systemd versions upstream! -->
<!-- See https://github.com/systemd/systemd/releases for the list of most recent releases. -->
<!-- For older version please use distribution trackers (see https://systemd.io/CONTRIBUTING#filing-issues). -->

**Used distribution**
 >  RHEL 8

**CPU architecture issue was seen on**
 > ppc64le

I noticed a warning in dissect code when trying to compile the latest master on RHEL 8 - this causes the compilation to fail with `--werror`:

```
[289/687] Compiling C object 'src/shared/5afaae1@@systemd-shared-247@sta/dissect-image.c.o'.

../../../../src/shared/dissect-image.c:464:43: warning: variable ‘usr_verity_uuid’ set but not used [-Wunused-but-set-variable]
                 usr_uuid = SD_ID128_NULL, usr_verity_uuid = SD_ID128_NULL;
                                           ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
../../../../src/shared/dissect-image.c:464:17: warning: variable ‘usr_uuid’ set but not used [-Wunused-but-set-variable]
                 usr_uuid = SD_ID128_NULL, usr_verity_uuid = SD_ID128_NULL;
                 ^~~~~~~~
../../../../src/shared/dissect-image.c:463:47: warning: variable ‘root_verity_uuid’ set but not used [-Wunused-but-set-variable]
         sd_id128_t root_uuid = SD_ID128_NULL, root_verity_uuid = SD_ID128_NULL,
                                               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
../../../../src/shared/dissect-image.c:463:20: warning: variable ‘root_uuid’ set but not used [-Wunused-but-set-variable]
         sd_id128_t root_uuid = SD_ID128_NULL, root_verity_uuid = SD_ID128_NULL,
                    ^~~~~~~~~      ^~~~~~~~~
```
